threat_event: Ransomware on the service laptop encrypts the local Customer Machine Library and the encrypted files sync to cloud storage, so the owner cannot reload a stopped customer machine
threat_source: Cybercriminal ransomware group (phishing email or malicious download)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email and web browsing on the same administrator account that runs engineering software; no backup independent of sync; restore never tested; no library index or hashes; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 laptop; SYS-01 file storage; BP-01 and BP-02 (Customer A and B lines that build grid equipment)
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-023, G-018, G-034); Customer A exhibit S4 (P03 G-039)
existing_controls: Built-in antivirus; automatic OS updates; full-disk encryption; 30-day version history
treatment_plan: Offline encrypted backups on two rotating drives with a quarterly test restore; standard daily account; customer-held program copies; security training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Malware on the laptop or a USB stick reaches a customer's PLC, HMI, or drive network when the owner connects to a machine
threat_source: Cybercriminal malware (incidental spread) or an infected stick
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sticks and laptop not scanned before connecting; Customer A scanning station skipped on about 6 night calls; sticks shared across customers; legacy virtual machine with no malware protection bridged to the machine network
affected_asset_or_process: Customer plant equipment; SYS-03; SYS-05; BP-01
regulatory_driver: Customer A exhibit S3 (P03 G-038); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-030, G-027)
existing_controls: Built-in antivirus on the laptop; Customer A scanning station used on day visits
treatment_plan: Never skip Customer A's station; scan every stick on the laptop before use; one encrypted stick per customer; host-only virtual machine; Wi-Fi off when cabled to a machine

threat_event: An attacker reaches Customer B's vacuum drying oven controls through the always-on cellular router and changes setpoints or stops a drying cycle
threat_source: Cybercriminal or opportunistic attacker scanning for exposed remote access devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Router always on; cloud portal account with a password only; local admin page accepted the factory default password until 2026-08-27; no per-session approval; never approved in writing by Customer B's plant management
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 router; Customer B drying oven PLC and HMI; BP-01
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-017, G-018, G-027); Customer B NDA (P03 G-044)
existing_controls: Default local password changed 2026-08-27; router powered off except for sessions Customer B approves by phone since 2026-09-03
treatment_plan: MFA on the router portal by 2026-09-30; written approval or removal decision from Customer B's plant management by 2026-10-31; replace with a Customer B owned gateway or remove the router by 2026-12-31

threat_event: Tampered or corrupted monitoring unit firmware is loaded on a utility substation cabinet because its hash was not checked
threat_source: Supply chain attacker or corrupted download
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No hash check before loading; firmware loaded on 4 cabinets in 2026 without verification
regulatory_driver: Customer A exhibit S5 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.5 flow-down; P03 G-040); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-014)
existing_controls: Firmware received only from Customer A
treatment_plan: Hash check before every load, recorded on the job ticket; tell Customer A about the 4 unverified loads

threat_event: Theft of the customer machine password spreadsheet through a cloud storage compromise or a stolen device gives an attacker passwords for 10 customer sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 PLC, HMI, drive, and plant Wi-Fi passwords in an ordinary spreadsheet; shared machine passwords rarely changed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 file storage; customer plant equipment
regulatory_driver: Customer A exhibit S1 (P03 G-036); Customer B and C NDAs (P03 G-044); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-016)
existing_controls: MFA on the productivity suite; laptop encrypted
treatment_plan: Password manager with a vault per customer; delete the spreadsheet and its version history; customers change shared passwords when work ends

threat_event: Takeover of the accounting SaaS owner account leads to changed bank details on invoices or a fake payment-change email to customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the accounting SaaS owner (administrator) account
existing_controls: Unique password saved in the browser; bookkeeper uses its own login with MFA
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA; tell customers in writing that bank details never change by email

threat_event: Customer A plant data uploaded to the AI vibration analytics trial is kept or used by the vendor beyond the service, breaching the exhibit
threat_source: AI vendor (data use under click-through terms)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trial started without reading the terms or getting Customer A's written consent; terms allow use of uploaded data to improve the service
regulatory_driver: Customer A exhibit S1 (P03 G-036); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-005)
treatment_plan: Stop uploading Customer A data; ask Customer A for written consent under a no-training data addendum, or have the vendor delete its data (P10)

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so no one can reach the library, email, or accounting, and customers cannot get their own programs back
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; MFA codes on one phone; no referral arrangement; no emergency access sheet
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-002, G-015)
treatment_plan: Customer-held program copies; referral arrangement with another controls technician; sealed recovery codes and emergency access sheet held by the owner's attorney; license and installer list (P05)

threat_event: The legacy engineering virtual machine (unsupported OS, no malware protection) is compromised and used to attack the laptop or a customer network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS never updated; bridged to whatever network the laptop is on
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 virtual machine; customer networks at older winding machine sites
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-025, G-024)
existing_controls: Used only for older winding machine controllers
treatment_plan: Host-only networking except when cabled to the one machine it serves; no internet; retire when the older controllers are replaced

threat_event: A USB stick or the laptop is lost or stolen from the van or a customer site, exposing customer programs and drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 8 unencrypted USB sticks; sticks hold programs for several customers
regulatory_driver: Customer B and C NDAs (P03 G-044); Customer A exhibit S1 (P03 G-036)
existing_controls: Laptop encrypted; van locked and alarmed; laptop not left in the van overnight
treatment_plan: Encrypted sticks, one per customer, wiped after each job

threat_event: The old laptop, still holding a library copy, is sold, recycled, or lost without being wiped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Old laptop in a drawer since 2025; no disposal procedure
affected_asset_or_process: Old laptop; Customer Machine Library copy
regulatory_driver: Customer A exhibit S7 (P03 G-042); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-010)
treatment_plan: Wipe or destroy the drive with a record; disposal rule in POL-01 section 8

threat_event: A compromised household device on the shared home network attacks the laptop
threat_source: Cybercriminal malware on a family device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Home network shared with family laptops, a smart TV, and a game console
existing_controls: Laptop host firewall on; SaaS traffic uses TLS
treatment_plan: Separate business Wi-Fi; household devices on the guest network

threat_event: A cyber incident is not recognized in time, or the 24-hour Customer A notice or an NDA notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident criteria, plan, contact list, or training before 2026-09-11
regulatory_driver: Customer A exhibit S4 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.1 and R1.2.2 flow-down; P03 G-039); Customer B and C NDAs (P03 G-045)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print contacts; walk through with the IT consultant

threat_event: A cyber incident costs more than the business can absorb, and Customer A's renewal is lost because the required cyber insurance is not in place
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: General liability policy only; Customer A requires $1 million cyber liability coverage from 2027-09-30 (exhibit S8)
affected_asset_or_process: The business (45% of receipts from Customer A)
treatment_plan: Get cyber liability quotes after the High risks are treated; bind before the renewal

threat_event: A hurricane damages the home office or the van and its equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Home office and van in Florida; spare instruments not duplicated
affected_asset_or_process: Home office; service van; field kit
existing_controls: Library synced to cloud storage; laptop travels with the owner; equipment insured
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. When a hurricane watch is issued, take the laptop, phone, and backup drive to the evacuation location
